rule: Covered = no exclusion of agricultural workers employed by firms; domestic-worker rules = farm work placed under the domestic-worker regime; separate regulation = farm workers excluded from the labor code but covered by a dedicated regulation; excluded = excluded from the labor code; unclear = no provision found.
source: Scope article of the labor law
rule_id: Tercakup = tidak ada pengecualian pekerja pertanian di perusahaan; aturan pekerja rumah tangga = pekerjaan pertanian ditempatkan di rezim pekerja rumah tangga; peraturan tersendiri = pekerja pertanian dikecualikan dari UU tetapi diatur peraturan khusus; dikecualikan = dikecualikan dari UU; belum jelas = tidak ditemukan ketentuan.

rule: In place = all workers may change employer without consent; partial = some workers or conditions; absent = consent required.
rule_id: Ada = semua pekerja boleh pindah majikan tanpa izin; sebagian = sebagian pekerja atau dengan syarat; tidak ada = perlu izin.

rule: In place = a statutory minimum that applies to non-nationals; partial = sectoral or by decision; absent = none or nationals only.
rule_id: Ada = upah minimum menurut undang-undang yang berlaku bagi bukan warga; sebagian = sektoral atau melalui keputusan; tidak ada = tidak ada atau hanya bagi warga.

rule: In place = electronic wage protection system for most workers; partial = major groups excluded.
rule_id: Ada = sistem perlindungan upah elektronik bagi sebagian besar pekerja; sebagian = kelompok besar dikecualikan.

rule: In place = migrant workers may join or form trade unions; partial = workers' committees or restricted unions; absent = not permitted.
rule_id: Ada = pekerja migran boleh bergabung atau membentuk serikat; sebagian = komite pekerja atau serikat terbatas; tidak ada = tidak diizinkan.

rule: Party or ratified, with year; not yet in force where the ILO's twelve-month rule applies.
rule_id: Pihak atau diratifikasi, dengan tahun; belum berlaku bila aturan dua belas bulan ILO berlaku.

rule: Dates and hours of the ban on outdoor work in direct sun, as announced.
rule_id: Tanggal dan jam larangan kerja di luar ruangan di bawah sinar matahari langsung, sebagaimana diumumkan.

rule: Level: international, regional, interregional or bilateral. Nature: binding treaty, agreement, memorandum of understanding, protocol or annex, standard contract, declaration or dialogue.
source: GLMM; Chilton, Posner & Woda; NORMLEX; UNTC
rule_id: Tingkat: internasional, regional, antarkawasan atau bilateral. Sifat: traktat mengikat, perjanjian, nota kesepahaman, protokol atau lampiran, kontrak standar, deklarasi atau dialog.
source_id: GLMM; Chilton, Posner & Woda; NORMLEX; UNTC

rule: Each feature counts 2 when in place, 1 when partial and 0 when absent or unclear. The visitor sets a weight from 0 to 3 for each feature; the score is the sum of weight × points. The stability check draws 10,000 random weightings (each weight uniform between 0 and 3, fixed seed) and reports how often each state ranks first.
rule_id: Setiap fitur bernilai 2 bila ada, 1 bila sebagian, dan 0 bila tidak ada atau belum jelas. Pengunjung memberi bobot 0 sampai 3 untuk tiap fitur; skornya adalah jumlah bobot × poin. Uji stabilitas menarik 10.000 kombinasi bobot acak (tiap bobot seragam antara 0 dan 3, seed tetap) dan melaporkan seberapa sering tiap negara berada di urutan pertama.
